values.note: Six full-hookup sites, eight with water and electric, four electric-only and three primitive.
Reservations highly recommended, by phone; arrive before dusk. Generators not allowed.

note: Small private campground at 900 Mining Town Rd, about 3 miles from Mountain City, on the edge of the Doe Mountain trail system: a trail leaves the campground, and day parking is sold to trail riders. Community pavilion. --Claude
summary: R&D Campground: rates confirmed ($30-45/day, cash, no monthly); 2025 map shows 21 sites (6 FHU, 8 W/E, 4 E, 3 primitive), showers + dump, year-round. OHV FLAG: sits on the Doe Mountain ATV trail system with a trail leaving the campground and trail-rider day parking. Google 4.9 (106).
flags: OHV (reviewer decides, not a drop): R&D is a base camp for the Doe Mountain trail system - the 2025 campground map marks 'TRAIL 17' leaving the campground and 'DAY PARKING'; prices page 'PARKING (for non campers riding the trails): $5/day'; menu 'DOE MOUNTAIN TRAIL MAP'. The operator pages don't call it an ATV campground in words, and nothing restricts it to riders.
PRIVATE: Google 4.9 (106 reviews). Price $30-45 under the gate. Long-stay: 'We no longer offer a monthly option for camping'; weekly = 4x daily; no wording against nightly guests - passes.

PHONE: the operator header lists '(423)534-9451 (423)534-4804'; Google has 423-534-9451. Stored 423-534-4804 is on the operator page - optional change 423-534-4804 -> 423-534-9451 (Google's and listed first).
SITES: count 19 (old note: 9 W/E + 10 tent) -> 21 from the 2025 map. Electric amperage not stated (left absent). No generators allowed.
WATERFRONT 'not waterfront' kept (no water on the map).
PIN fine: Google 36.436571,-81.829286 vs stored 36.43630,-81.82929 (~30 m), at the entrance; sites run ~150 m north up the hollow.
